The asset was regenerated by running the production menu command 'No Safe Circle/World/Build Room Scene Catalog' (RoomSceneCatalog.BuildAsset), never hand-edited; its diff against the pre-implementation asset (base_commit b440c4d0a582c990aa0bf06183d3e578456833c6) is exactly the four changed room bounds and three changed door centres and nothing else -- RuinedEntry's bounds and D1/D2's centres do not appear in the asset diff at all. Mutation-proof of non-tautology: in the same LowerVault MinZ 54f->53f mutation run, GeneratedCatalogAsset_RoomsMatchTheSameContractValues STILL PASSED, because it reads the untouched committed asset which still held 54, while the source-side VAL-001 test failed on the identical mutation (mutation-xml/mutation-log). That asymmetry is the evidence this is a real source/asset comparison, not a tautology. WHAT THIS GATE DOES NOT PROVE: this task carries downstream_integration_obligation INT-001, deliberately unsatisfied at landing. This change turns local main red: NoSafeCircle.DoorPrototype.Tests.Editor.World.CommittedRoomSourceSceneConformanceTests opens the five committed Assets/Scenes/Rooms/*.unity scenes and validates them against the moved catalog. Measured at commit 9e0a3b4b0f9654709da8edef7f21a30de47e7567: 70 selected, 64 passed, 5 failed, 1 skipped, against a baseline of 65 passing and 0 failing -- CommittedRoomSourceSceneConformanceTests.FiveCommittedRoomScenes_AreComposableWithPairedDoorAnchors, ChapelOfAshSceneTests.CommittedScene_ValidatesForComposition, FinalRoomSceneTests.CommittedScene_ValidatesForComposition, and two LowerVaultSceneTests, all one cause; RuinedEntry and BoneArchive do not fail. INT-001 is satisfied only once NSC-044 through NSC-048 and NSC-049's refresh have landed. This was knowingly not satisfied at landing on Vincent's explicit decision ('Land it, accept red main', 2026-09-22), because the pipeline satisfies a dependency only via committed conformance or an approved_integration receipt requiring the commit already be an ancestor of main, so no room could be built while NSC-101 sat on a branch; that decision is recorded here as authority for the state of main, not as a gate result or a human-approval decision for these two automated gates. CI does not run this fixture, and NSC-101 has no entry in Pipeline/TaskReviewAgent/authoritative_validation_policy.json; the GER Agent is deliberately holding that binding until verify_filter.py runs against it.
